builds.hypothesis:
Hecarim cleaves nearby enemies for [60 / 90 / 120 / 150 / 180 + (0.9) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage. If this Ability hits, he gains a stack that decreases its Cooldown by [0.75] seconds and increases its damage by [3 + (0.03) × AD[statFormula=2]]% for [8] seconds. Stacks up to [3] times.
Bloodthirster/Infinity Edge/Eclipse provide high AD; Grudge supplies armor penetration; Profane/Youmuu supply AD and lethality. Infinity Edge crit is not assumed to multiply this spell. First Strike adds a separately measured initiation bonus; Absolute Focus supplies adaptive stat only above its health threshold; Gathering Storm is fixed to 30min. Cash Back/Biscuit/Cosmic are economy/sustain/utility, not assumed direct damage multipliers.

Prestack exactly three Qs, keep trail/Move Speed state fixed, record fourth Q alone. Bloodthirster, Infinity Edge, Serylda's Grudge, Profane Hydra, Youmuu's Ghostblade, Eclipse. Required setup damage is excluded from scored ability. builds.name: Devastating Charge: speed becomes impact
builds.summary: Explore a high maximum-travel Devastating Charge result with finite setup and controlled one-item swaps. This is an experiment, not a certified optimum.
builds.goal: Explore a high maximum-travel Devastating Charge result with finite setup and controlled one-item swaps. This is an experiment, not a certified optimum.
builds.hypothesis: Rank-5 full E travel reaches 2 times (90 + 0.5 bonus AD), or 180 + bonus AD. Warpath turns observed bonus movement speed into AD, so Youmuu's active and movement states are part of the setup, not free extra damage. Shojin supplies AD and an amplification hypothesis whose eligibility on the attack-delivered E must be tested.
